root_relief.shape: semicircular caps tangent to straight slot walls

insertion_side: right/output side, plain left end first
method: All assembled pairs and moving relative rigid poses, with translation/rotation tip motion sampled <=0.5 mm. Same tracks drive viewer. Nominal tooth profile checked separately.
limits: Sampled rigid geometry, not continuous swept-volume proof or a physical fit test.
Oversized teeth require elastic deflection. No load, backlash or fatigue rating.
The plain insertion end has no axial hard stop; enforce software travel limits.
Pinion is free to turn during rack insertion. Remove front and rear angled axles in sequence. Lock eccentric bushings after setting light roller contact; preload force has not been measured.

guide_contact_constraints.interpretation: Rigid contact geometry restrains five axes; positive opposed preload is possible. Does not predict elastic stiffness or load capacity.
